author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-Four! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Andy Chambers and his team at Best Hobby have crowdfunded and are set to deliver Zeo Genesis, a new Sci-Fi skirmish game at about the scale and theme style of Robot Battlers like Warmachine or Infinity. Let's check it out!

Check out the rulebook Beta for FREE in digital  HERE: hhttps://best-hobby.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/ZG_SabreRidgeRulebook_PDF_2025-12-15.pdf
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 054 - ZEO GENESIS   by Andy Chambers, Gav Thorpe & Ryan Miller
